releases.body:
Live agent activity and lighter viewer fallback.

- Show Working/Still working indicators while an agent turn is running, including collapsed thinking/tool groups.
- Add a pending-assistant placeholder and a Tool-only response note for completed tool-only turns.
- Add skeleton loading for on-demand thinking/tool details and the New messages button.
- Add a lightweight /api/public/shares/:id/status endpoint and replace the 15s full-page poll with status checks plus a WebSocket watchdog.
- Service API version is now 3; plugin is 0.3.0. Upgrade the service and plugin together.

Breaking sync and share-lifecycle update.

- Sync credentials are now per-share Ed25519 signatures; the API key is only used to create or revoke shares.
- Shares expire 1 day after /share. Session updates no longer extend the TTL.
- Removed the 60s heartbeat and startup watcher resume. Sync is lazy and event-driven, with a one-time reconnect catch-up.
- Revoked metadata is deleted after 7 days.
- Service API version is now 2; plugin is 0.2.0. Upgrade the service and plugin together, then share existing sessions again.

Service-only release.

- Switches the favicon to a transparent, standalone chat bubble.
- Centers the bubble optically in the tab and shortens the tail.
- Cache-busts the favicon URL with ?v=3.
- Plugin/npm unchanged: opencode-session-share-plugin stays at 0.1.4.

Service-only release.

- Adds the chat-bubble favicon.
- Browser tab title now follows the session title.
- Plugin/npm unchanged: opencode-session-share-plugin stays at 0.1.4.

Image: ghcr.io/duo-huang/opencode-session-share:v0.1.5
Adds a GitHub repository link and icon to the viewer header and footer.
